environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Seven interleaved fresh-Node rounds; each cold build deletes tool disk cache; immediate warm build keeps cache. 24 Kodak PNGs, 288/384/480px, WebP q75, no preview. Every output SHA-256 multiset must match across all tools and cache states. imageway-control is identical source A/A. Default automatic imports are a separate three-round workload. buildMs includes candidate module loading, Vite build and emitted assets; processWallMs additionally includes process startup and post-build validation. Native/thread concurrency uses each tool default; not normalized. Node/libvips versions shared.
